response.overview: After a traumatic break-in shatters their sense of safety, Janell and Thomas leave behind their life in Atlanta, hoping a fresh start in a quiet town will help them heal. But when old acquaintances resurface and new temptations emerge, their attempt to rebuild begins to unravel. As trust fractures and hidden agendas collide, the couple finds themselves entangled in a web of suspicion, secrets, and choices that could change everything. "An Affair to Remember" is a suspense-driven drama about loyalty, deception, and the devastating cost of buried truths.
response.title: An.Affair.to.Remember
